items.title: 11.7.3 Electron kheenchne wala inductive effect (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.7.3 with Figure 11.12, printed page 259.

blocks.text: Electron kheenchne wale groups, jaise halogen atom, ka inductive effect negative (−I) hota hai. Halogen bond ke electrons ko carbon ki taraf se apni taraf kheenchta hai, aur yeh asar carbon-carbon bond tak jata hai; yahi negative inductive effect hai. Is se molecule mein permanent dipole (hamesha rehne wale do poles) ban jata hai: halogen atom par negative charge aur carbon par partial positive (thora positive) charge (Figure 11.12).

blocks.alt: Zanjeer C-C-C-C-Cl, carbons surkh mein 4, 3, 2, 1. C2-C1 bond par teen aur C1-Cl bond par chaar surkh chevrons Cl ki taraf. Charges: C2 par delta-delta+, C1 par delta+, Cl par delta-. Labels: Less positive charge than C1 (C2 par teer); Less electronegative (C1); More electronegative (Cl); Electron deficient C1 pulling electrons from C1-C2 covalent bond (C2-C1 bond par teer).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.12: Inductive effect: sigma bond ki polarization (kitab ki Figure 11.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cl sab se zyada electronegative hai, is liye C1–Cl bond ke electrons Cl ki taraf khinchte hain: Cl par δ⁻ aur C1 par δ⁺. Ab electron ki kami wala C1, C1–C2 bond ke electrons kheenchta hai, to C2 par bhi thora positive charge aata hai magar C1 se kam (δδ⁺). Chain mein aage yeh asar kamzor hota jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 11.12 mein C2 aur C1 dono par ‘δ++’ chhapa hai. Yeh figure ke apne label (C2 par C1 se kam positive charge) se nahi milta; sahi C1 par δ⁺ aur C2 par δδ⁺ hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Inductive effect ki tareef karein, aur saath wale carbon par methyl group aur chlorine atom ke asar ka muqabla karein (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: Inductive effect paas wale atom ya group ki wajah se σ bond ka permanent polar ho jana hai. Methyl group carbon ki taraf electrons dhakelta hai (+I), carbon ko kam positive banata hai aur wahan carbocation ko stable karta hai. Chlorine atom electrons kheenchta hai (−I), carbon ko partial positive banata hai, aur yeh dipole chain mein aage kamzor hota jata hai.

items: −I effect: halogen σ electrons kheenchta hai, C1 partial positive ho jata hai, C1 phir C2 se kheenchta hai, aur asar kam hota hua aage jata hai; permanent dipole.
